title: China's slowdown pushes New Zealand exporters to diversify away from their top buyer, RBNZ official tells CNBC
summary_full: New Zealand exporters are diverting shipments bound for China to new markets, as demand from the country's top buyer cools, a central bank official tells CNBC.
